content: Hello, this is Kevin from Amazon Customer Support. Am I speaking with Ms. Rivera?
Yes, this is her. Can we make this quick? I'm in the middle of something.

Of course, I'll do my best to be efficient. I'm calling about your recent order, there's a minor issue with customs clearance which is holding up the delivery. Have you received any emails from us about this?
No, I haven't seen anything. What kind of issue is this?

It's a new Amazon policy due to customs changes. Before we discuss details, could you please confirm the last four digits of the phone number on your account and your email address? This is just for verification.
Uh, sure. 3279 for the phone, and my email is s.rivera82@gmail.com. So what's going on with my order?

Thank you for verifying, Ms. Rivera. Your package has been flagged for a regulatory compliance fee. Amazon needs to process a refundable customs duty before shipping. It's a standard security step, and as soon as it's done, your package will move forward.
I've never had to pay that before. Are you sure this is legit?

I completely understand your concern. I'll reassure you that this is an Amazon-wide update affecting select orders. For your peace of mind, I can transfer you to a senior account specialist who handles these cases directly. Would you like to speak with them?
Okay, but please be quick.

Thank you. Please hold while I connect you to my supervisor, Ms. Patel.
Hello, Ms. Rivera, this is Ms. Patel from Amazon Regulatory Compliance. Thanks for your patience. I see the issue here, and I'll help you resolve it right away.
Alright. What do I need to do?

We require a temporary customs duty of $218. Once paid, it will be refunded to your original payment method within 24 hours. This is a standard Amazon safeguard. May I confirm if your billing address is still 458 Elmwood Drive?
Yes, that's right. So I just pay and get it back?

Exactly. We process it immediately, and your package will ship today. For compliance, we've partnered with Amazon-approved payment channels. Do you have access to Amazon gift cards or would you prefer a direct transfer using Bitcoin?
Uh, I don't really use Bitcoin. Is the gift card easier?

Absolutely, it's the simplest option. You can purchase two $100 Amazon gift cards from any nearby retailer or online. Once you have the codes, just read them to me so I can process the refund and release your package.
I'm not sure about this. Why can't I just pay on your site?

That's a great question, Ms. Rivera. For these regulatory fees, Amazon uses secure third-party gateways, which is why the gift card method is preferred. I assure you, the codes are used solely to register the payment, and your refund is guaranteed.
Alright, hold on, let me see if I can get them online.
Thank you for your cooperation. While you're doing that, could you also confirm the full name on your account to speed up the process?
Sandra Rivera, that's the name.
Perfect. Once you have the gift card codes, just let me know. If you run into any issues purchasing them, I can walk you through the steps. Would you like me to stay on the line while you do this?
Yeah, just stay. One sec.
Of course, take your time. I'm here to ensure this is as simple as possible for you.
Alright, I have the first card. The code is A1B2C3D4E5.
Thank you, Ms. Rivera. Please share the second code when ready. As soon as both are received, I'll process the payment and initiate your refund.
The second one is F6G7H8J9K0.
Thank you for providing both codes. I will now register your payment with our compliance team. You'll receive an email confirmation and your package tracking will update within the next hour.
Okay, I really need to go now. I'll look out for the email.
Thank you for your patience, Ms. Rivera. You've helped us resolve this quickly. If you have any other questions, don't hesitate to call Amazon support directly. Have a great day.
